data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'asara' which means 'to help' or 'to support'. Aasira is a name given to a girl who is expected to provide support and assistance in her community and family. The name Aasira carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aasira usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
